case_name: Deepankar Singh & Anr vs The State & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: The State & Anr (wife, police station Shahdara, Delhi)

facts_of_case: Petitioners filed a petition for quashing of the FIR No.356/2011 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Shahdara, Delhi against them and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash a criminal proceeding to demonstrate that the allegations made in the FIR are frivolous and without any basis.
legal_principles.held: Considering the above settlement between the parties, the petitioners have demonstrated that the allegations made in the FIR are frivolous and without any basis.

outcome.final_order: FIR No.356/2011 under Section 406/498A/34 Indian Penal Code registered at police station Shahdara, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.

use_for_drafting: divorce by mutual consent under Hindu Marriage Act
payment of settlement amount in court
